messages:
hana: FYI support ticket: several customers on AAD are seeing SSO errors after recent change. error: \"login failed: malformed NameID\". happening during SAML POST to auth-proxy.

carl: any sample SAML? could be assertion truncation or encoding issue. which login flow (hosted vs dedicated)?

hana: hosted. here's a sanitized assertion snippet we received from AAD (from logs):
```xml
<saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress\">verylongusername_with+symbols_and_very_long_domain_example-company.co</saml:NameID>
```
Auth-proxy logs: `ERROR saml: NameID length 256 exceeds DB column 200 -> drop_to_legacy` then downstream idp-proxy emits a SCIM PATCH removing extId.

dev-bot: deploy bot: rolled config mapping change 1717801200 -> mapping trimmed NameID to 200 chars by default (see PR #345).

meera: that's a red flag. we shouldn't silently truncate identity tokens. truncation breaks signature mapping and causes provisioning mismatches.

ops-oncall: repro in staging: send SAML with NameID length 250 -> auth-proxy truncates to 200, we then try to re-encrypt extId with KMS alias "alias/extid" and it fails because ciphertext header mismatch: `kms: decrypt failed: bad header` and subsequently provisioner writes empty extId.

security-bot: audit: config deploy 1717801200 noted. KMS rewrap job ran 1717803000 and had intermittent `NotAuthorizedException` for role `provisioner-worker`. https://audit.redwood.internal/kms/1717803000 :warning:

carl: why would truncation affect KMS? two possibilities: 1) truncation changes plaintext so rewrap can't find expected context, 2) the code path that handles long NameIDs triggers legacy migrator which uses a different KMS context. check rewrap worker logs.

ops-oncall: rewrap worker excerpts:
```
2026-04-07T15:05:13Z migrator INFO starting rewrap for tenant t-88 user u-999
2026-04-07T15:05:13Z migrator DEBUG attempting decrypt with context {"version":"v1"}
2026-04-07T15:05:13Z kms ERROR decrypt: bad header
2026-04-07T15:05:13Z migrator ERROR decrypt failed, aborting (no fallback)
2026-04-07T15:05:14Z provisioner WARN writing user u-999 with extId: null
```

meera: reading code: migrator only tries v1 context if NameID length > 200 (legacy support). so truncation made the auth-proxy create a shorter NameID, but migrator still expected legacy format because upstream metadata flagged `legacy:true`. messy.

hana: immediate mitigation: rollback mapping change that trims NameID OR change auth-proxy to reject overly long NameID with clear 400 so we don't produce inconsistent records. which is safer?

carl: prefer reject + user-facing error in hosted flows. Rolling back a deploy is noisy. Also add a canary check in migrator to not write null extId on decrypt failure.

ops-oncall: I'll add a guard: if rewrap/decrypt fails, do not mutate extId and emit an incident metric. PR: https://stash.redwood.internal/p/migrator/+/1022

security-bot: creating incident SEC-2026-060 for SAML NameID truncation + KMS rewrap failures, assigning @hana @ops-oncall @meera. Link: https://issues.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-060 :rotating_light:

meera: long-term: 1) increase DB extId column or store NameID separately (avoid truncation), 2) add explicit migration path for legacy v1->v2 KMS contexts with deterministic flags, 3) add unit+e2e tests covering SAML > DB length boundary.

hana: for now I'm opening a customer comms draft and will coordinate a rollback if customer impact continues after canary fixes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
